'''Sanus felines''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of animal. Often kept as pets, they were approximately two meters in length. They were among the creatures exhibited at [[Sok Brok's Fiftieth Annual Pet Show]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].
